summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes are additive only: rich/progress.py gets a private _Reader class, a _reader_context generator helper, a _make_progress builder, module-level open and wrap_file (with overloads for 'r'/'rt' and 'rb'), and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file (with overloads for open). tests/test_progress.py gets 25 new tests before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst gets the two requested subsections, and CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased/Added entry linking PR 1759. Nothing was committed. Not verified: I did not run the tests, mypy, or black, because the task forbade running repository code, so everything was checked by reading only. Open risks: on Python 3.6, typing.IO may declare mode and name as abstract, which could block _Reader instantiation; this is unverified and I followed the spec's rule that other attributes come from base classes. Some docstring lines exceed 88 characters.
